final: WITH department_counts AS (SELECT major.department AS department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id GROUP BY major.department), department_shares AS (SELECT department, member_count, 1.0 * member_count / (SELECT SUM(member_count) FROM department_counts) AS share FROM department_counts) SELECT department, member_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM department_shares) AS share_above_average FROM department_shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM department_shares) ORDER BY share DESC, department
